name: HSE National Protocol for Autism Assessment and Intervention Pathways
description: HSE national protocol effective 25 March 2026 for autism assessment and intervention pathways across Irish health services, including HSE and HSE-funded services and relevant private providers.
intended_use: Use as the national clinical/pathway framework while keeping actual service access and adult public/private availability separate.
audience_or_context: Clinicians, services and people in the Republic of Ireland inspecting the national autism-assessment framework.
limitations: A national assessment protocol does not prove that every age group has the same publicly funded access route everywhere.
The protocol describes clinical/pathway standards and must not be used to contradict HSE's current statement that it does not provide adult autism assessments.
Local service implementation can still affect referral destination and waits.
cost_or_access_notes: Publicly accessible online; effective from 25 March 2026.
conflicts_of_interest: HSE authored and implements the protocol; ND Oracle records the official framework without assuming uniform service capacity or outcome.

provenance.method: HSE national autism protocol page checked on 2026-09-04 for effective date, service scope and tiered assessment framing. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
